```{r setup-mascot_moods, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_moods-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_moods")
```

```{r mascot_moods-heading, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
guide_heading(
  paste0(mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name, "'s ", nrow(mascot::mascot_moods(studio_character)), " moods"),
  "Moods"
)
```

<div class="pg-muted">

The five shared moods come first. A character may add its own; a mood that is not available falls back to the
one named in fallback.

</div>

```{r mascot_moods-table, echo = FALSE}
guide_each_character(function(ch) guide_table(mascot::mascot_moods(ch)))
```

```{r mascot_moods-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_moods", studio_character)
```
